answer: Creating N fake identities costs N times the bond plus N times the hash work, so an attacker flooding the economy pays linearly in capital and compute. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond at the grove registry inlet before voting, where a sonnet-style proof-of-work hash is folded into the bond commitment. Honest agents recover their stake on exit; duplicate fingerprints tied to one inlet are slashed, making mass identity farming economically irrational. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
